notes: Timeline = gapless mp3 decode of audio/drift.mp3; Demucs stems shifted by the measured offset (analysis/work/stem_offset.json). Tempo constant: 85.766 BPM (period 0.69958 s), fitted over the whole song on drum+mix onset envelopes, phase refined on kick attacks; first beat 0.496 s. Bar phase: beat index 2 mod 4 is beat 1 (set explicitly: harmony changes and the main kick fall there, snares on 2 & 4); first downbeat 1.895 s. Sections start on the downbeat of the bar holding the opening word of their first lyric line; pickups in the last 2 beats stay in the previous section, and the choruses/outro key on their stressed word ("die", "fighting") because their lines open with a long pickup. Envelopes: 100 fps, 46 ms RMS, one-pole smoothing (10 ms attack / 90 ms release), each /99th percentile, clipped 0..1. low <150 Hz, mid 150-2000 Hz, high >4 kHz of the mix; vocal/drums/bass/other = stem RMS. Onsets [time, strength 0-1] from the drums stem: kick = <120 Hz attacks (390); snare = 1.5-5 kHz attacks with a noisy tail (140); hat = >7 kHz attacks away from snares/kicks (350); vocal = note onsets of the vocal stem.
